title: Flappy Robert Pattinson: Shaken, Not Sparkled
story: Edward Cullen just got his licence to kill. Flap the freshly-announced, still-sparkling new 007 through a gun barrel full of Forks forest without spilling a single dry martini.
inspiration: Robert Pattinson officially named the next James Bond by Amazon MGM / 007 on 2026-11-16 (X trends: Bond, Edward Cullen, Twilight, Daniel Craig; https://x.com/i/trending/2122345414871445745). Timelines flooded with Edward-Cullen-as-007 and Batman-and-Bond memes. Bird: Pattinson in a tux (Cannes 2012, Wikimedia Commons) paled and sparkled; pillars: dry martinis; sky: 007 gun barrel framing a misty Forks-style forest. Archetype: Twitchy (apex ~25) because he's shaken, not stirred. Rolling window needed a second extreme day after Brick/Giant and floaty Moon/Hover days.
